layouts.name: Full course with both chicanes
layouts.description: The operator identifies its full circuit, zonal alternatives and two chicanes, with 5222 m total asphalt. Its published aerial views identify the northern loop and northern short-course return. This exact independent public-node route retains the full northern loop and both small straight chicanes. The separately mapped Sector Boxes pit route is excluded. Configuration identity, timing choice and direction remain draft.

The operator identifies zonal alternatives and its aerial photograph independently confirms the paved northern shortcut. Descriptive naming does not assert an official layout name. The pit route is excluded.

sources.title: Aggregate layout identification
sources.evidenceNote: The supplied general-entry shape includes the full northern loop, its short-course return and straight alternatives. The operator identifies the general circuit, zonal alternatives and both chicanes, totaling 5222 m of asphalt. These independently mapped complementary courses preserve that physical configuration set, with the Sector Boxes pit route excluded. Its unique-edge distance is not a timed lap; no coordinates are scaled to the catalogue scalar, and exact historical branch and timing choice remains draft. The independent unique branch distance is 5240.7 m; no coordinates are adjusted to a catalogue scalar distance. Identification only; no image coordinates copied.
